component.name: open-source-gallery
component.description: Self-hosted client photo gallery and sales platform (PHP 8.2+, MySQL/SQLite, vanilla JS)

properties.name: sbom:completeness
properties.value: INCOMPLETE - no trivy or syft available in this environment. Component list below is hand-derived from Phase 0 and covers runtime dependencies only.

components.name: php
components.description: Runtime. Extensions required: pdo, pdo_mysql or pdo_sqlite, gd, curl, mbstring, json

components.name: stripe-checkout
components.description: Payments. Hosted Checkout plus js.stripe.com on the client. No server-side SDK vendored: the integration is direct HTTPS to api.stripe.com.

properties.name: third-party-php-packages
properties.value: none - the application vendors no Composer runtime dependencies. PHPUnit is a dev-only requirement.
